about: One self-contained house-part file per Mount Dora building; README.md in this folder documents the format

poses.note: fitIoU: intersection over union of the placed outline with the measured footprint (features.json geographicGeometry); medians of an even count average the middle two

ridges.note: lidar ridges of confident (>= 0.7) gable and hip roofs, turned into the part frame; a ridge parallel to a wall is within 5 degrees of a part axis

storeys.note: the art kit draws treatment.stories; the native walls and floors use storeys.count
